market_name: Will 7 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability shift is a real jump or thin-liquidity noise; cross-check 2y Treasury yield and fed funds futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Confirm TLT direction vs move in 2y/10y yields; look for any Fed speaker headlines or data surprise driving the shift.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether risk assets (SPY) are falling in tandem (recession read) or rising (liquidity read) to interpret the easing signal.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate magnitude vs realized TLT move; check if dollar and gold corroborate the dovish thesis.
time_plan.12h: Final check: did TLT hold its move into the close of the window; note any mean reversion in the prediction-market probability.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 7 Fed cuts in 2026 (175bps of easing) signals a dramatically more dovish rate path, most likely driven by recession/crisis fears. Falling expected policy rates pull Treasury yields down and bond prices up; long-duration TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a dovish repricing. Magnitude is modest over 12h because this is a slow-moving macro story and much of the easing path is already priced in rates markets.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Verify DXY and EURUSD reaction; distinguish genuine dovish repricing from risk-off dollar bid.
time_plan.1h: Check whether the move is US-specific (rate differential) versus global risk sentiment driving safe-haven USD demand.
time_plan.2h: Reassess UUP vs TLT consistency; if dollar rises despite dovish bets, thesis is compromised by risk-off flows.
time_plan.6h: Review any overseas central-bank headlines shifting relative policy expectations.
time_plan.12h: Final check on UUP direction and whether the prediction-market probability held.

predictions.reasoning: Aggressive expected Fed easing narrows US rate differentials versus other economies, typically weakening the dollar. A surge in 7-cut probability is dollar-negative. The proxy is noisier than Treasuries because FX also depends on relative central-bank paths abroad and risk-off flows can paradoxically support the dollar.

evidence_used: Market question asks about 7 (175bps) of Fed cuts in 2026, an extreme dovish scenario
Standard macro linkage: lower expected policy rates lift bond prices and weaken the dollar
Rate-cut expectations typically accompany recession/risk-off conditions
uncertainty_notes: The 'military_conflict' topic tag appears mislabeled; this is a monetary-policy market
Prediction markets on multi-cut tail scenarios are often thin and noisy
Much of the Fed path is already priced into liquid rates markets, limiting fresh signal
A dovish shift could be driven by either benign (soft landing) or crisis dynamics, which have opposite equity implications

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks the tail probability of an aggressively dovish Fed (7 cuts = 175bps in 2026). A sharp rise in that probability signals expectations of deep easing, typically recession-driven. The cleanest liquid implications are long Treasuries up (TLT) and the dollar down (UUP). Both moves are expected to be modest over a 12h window and well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so neither is tradable; confidence is low because the easing path is largely pre-priced and the signal is noisy.
key_assumptions: A probability move in this market reflects genuine shift in Fed easing expectations, not thin-market noise
Lower expected rates transmit to lower Treasury yields and a softer dollar
The move is not already fully reflected in bond and FX markets
failure_modes: The anomaly is thin-liquidity noise in a low-probability tail market with no real information
Dovish repricing coincides with risk-off flows that bid up the dollar, reversing the UUP thesis
Rate path is already priced, so Treasuries barely react
Market is mislabeled/misinterpreted and the move reflects unrelated flows
12h magnitude far below 700bps, so no tradable signal even if direction is correct
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
